This is now the level that is an upper limit for recovery, but buyers need to muster a powerful response to test it.
Four-Hour Chart Signals Further Downside Risk

On the 4-hour chart, HBAR is consolidating its gains and heading back to the $0.12 level from its highs seen in late September. The ongoing sell-off has driven the token near the bottom of its Bollinger Bands. The bottom of its lower band is at $0.07103, and the top of its upper band is at $0.11322.
HBAR is trading at $0.09212, which is close to the middle line of the chart's trend indicator. Source:

This formation indicates that the sellers are still holding the upper hand in the recent price trend. But a turn up from below $0.09212 would be better for the near term and could create resistance at $0.10.
Monthly Triangle Keeps the $0.57 Level in Focus

HBAR continues to trade inside of a long-term triangle pattern, as seen on the monthly chart shared on X. Both rising support and descending resistance continue to the lows from 2020 and 2021 highs, respectively. The price has been compressed between these two trending lines over the past few years, hence the pattern.

This level corresponds to the peak from the provided market data that occurred in the past. However, this is a conditional projection, and the price hasn't confirmed a breakout above the descending resistance.
Support and Resistance Levels to Watch

The immediate support level is around $0.0820, the daily low for HBAR. If the price stays below this level for an extended period, it may reach the lower Bollinger Band around $0.07103. Traders can also watch to see whether buyers support the wider uptrend on the monthly chart.

The good news is that HBAR will need to rally to $0.09212 to threaten its downtrending near-term condition. Further resistance could emerge around $0.10 and the recent peak above $0.12. A close-out above the monthly triangle's resistance would support the big-time recovery outlook.

title: Hedera (HBAR) Price Analysis as Long-Term Compression Tests Support
